display.purpose: Hero name headline only, italic variant marks the accent word.

headline.purpose: Section titles: Mission quote, About, Services, Contact.

body.purpose: Taglines, bio copy, service descriptions. Max ~64ch line length.

label.purpose: Kickers, tag pills, duration/price micro-labels. Always uppercase, bold, tracked.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Service rows and interactive cards on hover, paired with translateY(-3px).

shadows.name: floating-badge
shadows.purpose: Hero floating quote badge and overlapping elements.

shadows.name: hero-portrait
shadows.purpose: Largest, softest shadow — reserved for the single most prominent image.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: Slow, calm ease-out for all scroll-triggered reveals (0.8-1.0s).

motion.name: ease-transition
motion.purpose: Same curve for hover/UI transitions (250ms), consistent editorial feel.

components.name: Primary Button (dark)
components.description: Highest-emphasis CTA on light backgrounds, e.g. hero Telegram CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #3b2e26; color: #f6efe4; padding: 16px 26px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c98e84; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Terracotta CTA used inside the dark Contact panel and header.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: #c98e84; color: #ffffff; padding: 16px 26px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-accent:active { opacity: 0.75; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3b2e26; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag / Chip
components.description: Small uppercase pill for eyebrows and service tags.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #e4cfc6; color: #7a4e45; border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 16px; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Service Row Card
components.description: Interactive link row: thumbnail, title/tag/description, price/CTA. The site's signature component.
components.html:
Account Review

Profile audit, personality unpacking and positioning.

150 €
components.css: .ds-service-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 128px 1fr auto; gap: 32px; align-items: center; background: #f8f2e8; border-radius: 24px; padding: 22px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(59, 46, 38, 0.04); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); } .ds-service-row:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 22px 44px rgba(59, 46, 38, 0.12); } .ds-service-row__thumb { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 18px; background: #e2d4c5; } .ds-service-row__title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 24px; margin: 0 0 8px; color: #3b2e26; } .ds-service-row__desc { font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #6b5a4e; margin: 0; } .ds-service-row__price { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 30px; color: #3b2e26; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Low-emphasis pill control showing the other language's code; never competes with the primary CTA beside it.
components.css: .ds-lang-toggle { cursor: pointer; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 46, 38, 0.2); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Nunito Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #3b2e26; transition: opacity 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1); } .ds-lang-toggle:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-lang-toggle:active { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-lang-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c98e84; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The site reads as a real person's creative workspace, not a productized funnel: soft cream walls, terracotta accents, natural light. Every surface is warm and matte — no gradients, no glass, no corporate blue. The pacing is slow and editorial, like flipping through a mentor's own portfolio rather than scrolling a SaaS pricing page. Playfair Display carries the personality (large, confident, occasionally italic for warmth); Nunito Sans stays quiet and does the informational work. This system explicitly rejects generic SaaS/agency consultant templates — corporate blue gradients, stock-photo grids, hero-metric stat rows, gradient-text headlines — and loud influencer/hustle-culture aesthetics — neon accents, countdown urgency, aggressive upsell language. The brand is one real person's warm, editorial space.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (#c98e84, dusty terracotta) used sparingly — tags, CTAs, italic pull-quotes, selection color
Fully rounded pill buttons and generously rounded cards (24–28px), never sharp corners
Playfair Display italic as the signature warmth device (accent words in headlines, pull-quotes, badges)
Flat, matte surfaces layered by warmth (cream → tan → terracotta → near-black), no shadows for depth except soft ambient lift on hover
Slow reveals (0.8–1.0s) — nothing snaps or bounces

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Only #c98e84 (dusty terracotta) carries color intent across the whole site. Every other value is a neutral tinted from the ink-to-parchment ramp. If a second saturated color is needed, tint it from the existing ramp rather than introducing a new hue.

rules.name: The Italic Warmth Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display italic is reserved for moments of personality: the accent word in the H1, pull-quotes, the floating hero badge, service numerals. Never used for body copy or functional UI text — it marks emotional beats only.

rules.name: The Diffuse-Only Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in the system uses the ink color at low opacity (4–16%) with a large blur radius. No hard-edged or dark shadows anywhere — the warmth of the palette carries into elevation too.

dos: Do keep the accent color (#c98e84) to a single deliberate role per section — a CTA, a tag, or a pull-quote, never more than one saturated moment per screenful.
Do use full pill radius (999px) on every button, no exceptions.
Do reserve Playfair Display italic for personality beats (accent words, quotes, badges), never for body copy or UI labels.
Do keep shadows diffuse and ink-tinted (4–16% opacity, large blur) — never a hard, dark drop shadow.
Do pace reveals slowly (0.8–1.0s, cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)) — this is an editorial, unhurried brand, not a SaaS product.
donts: Don't introduce corporate blue gradients, stock-photo grids, hero-metric stat rows, or gradient-text headlines — the generic SaaS/agency consultant template this brand explicitly rejects.
Don't use neon accents, countdown urgency, or aggressive upsell language — the loud influencer/hustle-culture aesthetic this brand explicitly rejects.
Don't use sharp corners or hard shadows anywhere; every corner is rounded, every shadow is soft.
Don't add a second saturated hue. If more color is needed, tint further along the existing ink-to-parchment ramp.
Don't use top/left/width/height in any animation — transform and opacity only, per the site's hardware-acceleration rule.
